summary: ON CERTAIN MOTOR HOMES, THE SPARE WHEEL,WHEN INSTALLED ON THE FRONT AXLE, MAY CONTACT THE FRONT BRAKE CALIPER MOUNTING BRACKETS AND THE DRIVER MAY EXPERIENCE A GRINDING/SCRAPING NOISE IN THE FRONT WITH THE SPARE WHEEL INSTALLED.

title: Mazda Motor Corp.: ENGINE MOUNT (5,700 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN PASSENGER VEHICLES, THE NO. 4 LEFT SIDE ENGINE MOUNT BOLT MAY LOOSEN IF A SUDDEN RAPID ACCELERATION IS REPEATEDLY PERFORMED.

title: Harley-Davidson Motor Company: EXHAUST PIPE (35,112 affected)
summary: CERTAIN MOTORCYCLES WERE BUILT WITH A CONDITION WHEREBY THE PANT LEG OF SOME RIDERS CAN HAVE DIRECT CONTACT WITH  THE EXHAUST PIPE.

title: Keystone RV Company: PART 567/CERTIFICATION & FMVSS 110 (11 affected)
summary: CERTAIN TRAVEL TRAILERS FAIL TO COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF PART 567, "CERTIFICATION," AND FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 110, "TIRE SELECTION AND RIMS." THE GROSS VEHICLE WEIGHT RATING (GVWR) AND THE TIRE INFORMATION LABELS DENOTING THE TIRE PRESSURE IS INCORRECT.

title: NABI Bus, LLC: SR-7 SPRING BRAKE MODULATING VALVE/BENDIX (164 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN TRANSIT BUSES EQUIPPED WITH BENDIX SR-7 SPRING BRAKE MODULATING VALVES, THE INTERNAL RUBBER CHECK VALVE MAY LEAK CAUSING A DELAY IN THE APPLICATION OF THE SPRING BRAKES TO PARK THE VEHICLE AFTER THE OPERATOR PULLS THE DASH VALVE BUTTON.

title: DAIMLERCHRYSLER MANUFACTURING INTL: REAR AIRCONDITIONING/INTERIOR LAMPS (4,433 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN TRUCKS EQUIPPED WITH REAR AIR CONDITIONING SYSTEM, THE INTERIOR LAMP IS EQUIPPED WITH AN 18W LAMP AND A SCATTERING LENS.  IN EXTREMELY HOT AND HUMID CONDITIONS, THE COMBINATION OF HEAT AND HUMIDITY, AND THE HEAT FROM THE LAMP DUE TO EXTREME LONG TERM OPERATION, CAN DISTORT THE SCATTERING LENS.

title: Shyft Group: STEERING GEAR ASSEMBLY/ZF (89 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN MOTOR HOMES AND FIRE TRUCKS, THE STEERING GEAR ASSEMBLY CONTAINS A SPACER WITH INCORRECT DIMENSIONS.  A SPACER OF INSUFFICIENT HEIGHT ALLOWS FOR EXCESSIVE PLAY IN THE RETURN FUNCTION OF THE RECIRCULATION BALLS AND, AS A CONSEQUENCE, THERE IS A FAILURE IN THE CIRCULATORY FUNCTION OF THESE BALLS.

title: Suzuki Motor USA, LLC: SHIFT CABLE RETAINING CLIP (14,251 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN VEHICLES EQUIPPED WITH 5-SPEED MANUAL TRANSMISSIONS, DUE TO IMPROPER SHAPE OF THE CLIP, THE RETAINING CLIP THAT KEEPS THE GEAR SHIFT CABLE ATTACHED TO THE GEAR SHIFT LEVER CAN CONTACT THE GEAR SHIFT LEVER HOUSING IF EXCESSIVE LATERAL FORCE IS APPLIED WHEN SHIFTING TO FIRST GEAR.

title: AMERICAN TRUCK COMPANY: SR-7 SPRING BRAKE MODULATING VALVE/BENDIX (11 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN CREW AND STANDARD CAB TRUCKS EQUIPPED WITH BENDIX SR-7 SPRING BRAKE MODULATING VALVES, THE INTERNAL RUBBER CHECK VALVE MAY LEAK CAUSING A DELAY IN THE APPLICATION OF THE SPRING BRAKES TO PARK   THE VEHICLE AFTER THE OPERATOR PULLS THE DASH VALVE BUTTON.

title: FREIGHTLINER LLC: SR-7 SPRING BRAKE VALVE ASSEMBLY/BENDIX/PARKER (75,000 affected)
summary: CERTAIN FREIGHTLINER SCHOOL BUS CHASSIS, HEAVY TRUCKS, AND THOMAS BUILT SCHOOL BUSES MANUFACTURED BETWEEN JULY 2002 AND JULY 3, 2007, EQUIPPED WITH BENDIX SR-7 SPRING BRAKE CONTROL VALVES.  THE PARKER SCV BRASS 90 DEGREE SINGLE CHECK VALVES (SCV) WHICH ATTACH TO THE SUPPLY PORT OF A BENDIX SR-7 SPRING BRAKE MODULATING VALVE CAN BREAK APART.  PIECES OF THE PARKER SCV CAN BECOME LODGED INSIDE THE SR-7 SPRING BRAKE MODULATING VALVE, POTENTIALLY CAUSING EITHER LEAKAGE OUT OF THE SR-7 VALVE OR PREVENTING AIR FROM PROPERLY EXHAUSTING FROM THE SR-7 VALVE.   ALSO, DUE TO A MANUFACTURING DEFECT IN THE INTERNAL RUBBER CHECK VALVE INSIDE THE SR-7 SPRING BRAKE MODULATING VALVES, THE VALVES CAN BECOME DEFORMED AND NOT SEAT PROPERLY.

title: FLEETWOOD ENTERPRISES, INC.: FRONT AXLE WEIGHT INCORRECT/PART 567 (56 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN CLASS C MOTOR HOMES, THE FRONT AXLE WEIGHT, IN AN UNLOADED CONDITION, MAY EXCEED THE FRONT GROSS AXLE WEIGHT RATING (GAWR) OF 4600 POUNDS.

title: Harley-Davidson Motor Company: EXHAUST PIPE/VRSCR (2,403 affected)
summary: CERTAIN MOTORCYCLES WERE BUILT WITH A CONDITION WHEREBY THE PANT LEG OF SOME RIDERS CAN HAVE DIRECT CONTACT WITH  THE   EXHAUST PIPE.

title: Big Tex Trailer Manufacturing, Inc.: RAMP HANGER POCKET (321 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN FLATBED UTILITY TRAILERS, THERE IS AN INSUFFICIENT WELD OF THE RAMP HANGER POCKETS THAT STORE THE RAMPS WHEN NOT IN USE ON THE LEFT AND RIGHT UNDERSIDE OF THE TRAILER BED.  IF THE WELD IS INSUFFICIENT, IT COULD CAUSE THE RAMP HANGER POCKET TO DETACH, DROPPING THE RAMP TO THE GROUND OR ROADWAY.

title: Suburban Manufacturing CO: GAS COOKING APPLIANCE (232 affected)
summary: CERTAIN SUBURBAN GLASS TOP, SEALED BURNER RANGES AND COOK TOPS WITH SERIAL NUMBERS INCLUDED IN A RANGE BEGINNING WITH 063413053 AND ENDING WITH 064704399, MANUFACTURED BETWEEN AUGUST 22 AND NOVEMBER 22, 2006, P/NOS. 2950A, 2951A, 2952A, AND 2953A.  THESE RANGES WERE INSTALLED AS ORIGINAL EQUIPMENT ON CERTAIN RECREATIONAL VEHICLES AS WELL AS SOLD AS AFTERMARKET EQUIPMENT.  A THREADED CONNECTOR ON THE TUBE BETWEEN THE BURNER VALVE AND THE BURNER MAY NOT HAVE BEEN FULLY TIGHTENED DURING THE MANUFACTURING PROCESS.

title: FOUR WINDS INTERNATIONAL: IMPROPER ROUTING/SUPPORT OF LP GAS LINE TO KITCHEN (72 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN MOTOR HOMES, THE FLEXIBLE GAS LINE SUPPLYING PROPANE TO THE APPLIANCES IN THE KITCHEN SLIDE-OUT ROOM MAY BE IMPROPERLY ROUTED OR SUPPORTED.

title: FREIGHTLINER LLC: STEERING ARM/TIE ROD ARM (18,000 affected)
summary: FREIGHTLINER IS RECALLING CERTAIN SCHOOL BUS CHASSIS, HEAVY TRUCKS, VAN CHASSIS, RV MOTORHOME CHASSIS MANUFACTURED FROM JANUARY 5 TO MAY 17, 2007, EQUIPPED WITH AXLE ALLIANCE COMPANY (AAC) FRONT AXLES.  DURING THE FRONT AXLE ASSEMBLY, THE FASTENERS THAT ATTACH THE STEERING ARM OR TIE ROD ARMS TO THE SPINDLE MAY BE OVER OR UNDER TIGHTENED.

title: MAGURA USA CORPORATION: BRAKE MASTER CYLINDERS (230 affected)
summary: CERTAIN MAGURA 190 RADIAL BRAKE MASTER CYLINDERS, P/NOS. 0120429, 0120431, 0120432, 0120436, 0120438, AND 0120439, SOLD FOR USE AS AFTERMARKET EQUIPMENT FOR MOTORCYCLES.  DUE TO AN INCORRECT MANUFACTURING PROCESS, DEFECTS ON THE BASIC MATERIAL MAY LEAD TO CRACKS IN THE BRAKE MASTER CYLINDER POSSIBLY LEADING TO TOTAL FAILURE OF THE BRAKE SYSTEM.

title: Maserati North America, Inc.: ABS/ANTI-SKID STABILITY SYSTEM ECU (718 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN PASSENGER VEHICLES EQUIPPED WITH AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSIONS, A DEFECT IN THE ANTILOCK BRAKE/ANTI-SKID SYSTEM (ABS/ASR) ELECTRONIC CONTROL UNIT (ECU) SOFTWARE MAY PREVENT THE SYSTEM FROM FUNCTIONING PROPERLY.   A LOSS OF FUNCTION MAY RESULT IN A LOSS OF CERTAIN ENHANCED STABILITY AND BRAKING CONTROL DURING SOME HIGH SPEED MANEUVERS AND HIGH SPEED BRAKING.

title: PACCAR Incorporated: RADIATOR TIE ROD INSTALLATION (66 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN MEDIUM DUTY VEHICLES, THE RIGHT SIDE STABILIZING ROD, WHICH SPANS THE COOLING MODULE AND THE RIGHT FRAME RAIL BRACKET, WAS INADVERTENTLY DESIGNED TOO CLOSE IN PROXIMITY TO THE ALTERNATOR POSITIVE ELECTRICAL TERMINAL POST.  IN THE EVENT THE PROTECTIVE RUBBER BOOT ON THE TERMINAL POST WAS REMOVED OR CRACKED AND THE ENGINE MOUNTS ALLOWED THE ENGINE TO ROCK, ELECTRICAL ARCING COULD OCCUR BETWEEN THE RADIATOR TIE ROD HARDWARE ON THE FRAME SIDE AND THE ALTERNATOR TERMINAL POST WHILE THE ENGINE IS RUNNING.

title: Daimler Commercial Buses NA: FAN MOTOR HOSE (34 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN TRANSIT BUSES EQUIPPED WITH CONFIGURATION FC510 HIGH PRESSURE FAN MOTOR HOSES, THE WRONG HOSE SPECIFICATION WAS SELECTED.

title: MONACO COACH CORPORATION: CONNECTING ROD FAILURE/CUMMINS (747 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN MOTOR HOMES BUILT WITH CUMMINS  ISL CM850 DIESEL ENGINES, THE CONNECTING ROD CONTAINS A MACHINING DEFECT IN THE WRIST PIN BUSHING OF THE ROD THAT COULD CAUSE A SEIZURE OF THE PISTON PIN.

title: FREIGHTLINER LLC: CONNECTING ROD FAILURE/CUMMINS (642 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN MOTOR HOMES BUILT WITH CUMMINS  ISL CM850 DIESEL ENGINES, THE CONNECTING ROD CONTAINS A MACHINING DEFECT IN THE WRIST PIN BUSHING OF THE ROD THAT COULD CAUSE A SEIZURE OF THE   PISTON PIN.

title: WESTERN RECREATIONAL VEHICLES, INC.: CONNECTING ROD FAILURE/CUMMINS (58 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN MOTOR HOMES BUILT WITH CUMMINS  ISL CM850 DIESEL ENGINES, THE CONNECTING ROD CONTAINS A MACHINING DEFECT IN THE WRIST PIN BUSHING OF THE ROD THAT COULD CAUSE A SEIZURE OF THE PISTON PIN.

title: Silver Eagle Manufacturing Company: WHEEL BEARING SPINDLE NUTS (700 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN TRAILERS BUILT TO U.S. TANK-AUTOMOTIVE AND ARMAMENTS COMMAND SPECIFICATIONS, THE WHEEL BEARING SPINDLE NUTS INSTALLED ON THE WHEEL AND AXLE ASSEMBLIES MAY BE OVER-TORQUED.

title: GM DAEWOO AUTO & TECHNOLOGY COMPANY: SEAT BELT BUCKLE (78 affected)
summary: CERTAIN VEHICLES LOCATED IN GUAM AND SAIPAN WERE BUILT WITH A SEAT BELT BUCKLE WITH AN IMPROPER ULTRASONIC WELD OF THE SPRING RIB AND FIXATION RIB OF BUCKLE UNDERCOVER IN BOTH FRONT SEAT BELTS.  A SPRING RIB OR FIXATION RIB COULD BREAK AND REMAIN INSIDE THE BUCKLE, AND THE SEAT BELT TONGUE MAY NOT BE INSERTED INTO THE BUCKLE, OR THE PUSH BUTTON MAY BECOME STUCK, RESULTING IN AN OCCUPANT NOT BEING ABLE TO UNLATCH THE BUCKLE.

title: Keystone RV Company: INCORRECT WIRING TO THE WATER HEATER (596 affected)
summary: CERTAIN FIFTH WHEEL RECREATIONAL TRAILERS MAY HAVE INCORRECT WIRING TO THE WATER HEATER.  IF THE WIRING IS INCORRECT, THE GAS VALVE ON THE WATER HEATER COULD OPEN AND ALLOW LIQUID PROPANE (LP) GAS INTO THE BURNER TUBE WHEN THE ELECTRIC SWITCH IS TURNED ON.

title: Keystone RV Company: HUB PAINT (49 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN FIFTH WHEEL RECREATIONAL TRAILERS, EXCESS PAINT MAY CAUSE THE LUG NUTS TO LOSE TORQUE OVER TIME AND COULD ULTIMATELY CAUSE WHEEL SEPARATION IF THE TORQUE IS NOT MAINTAINED.

title: PLAN 9, INC.: LED DOME LIGHT/POSSIBLE FIRE (337 affected)
summary: CERTAIN PLAN 9, INC. 3 AND 6 WATT LED DOME LIGHTS, P/NOS. ELT01 AND ELT02, SOLD AS ACCESSORY LIGHTS FOR RECREATIONAL VEHICLES.  A RESISTOR MAY OVERHEAT IN THE CASE OF A SEMICONDUCTOR FAILURE.

title: International Motors, LLC: SR-7 SPRING BRAKE MODULATING VALVE/BENDIX (10,882 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN 6X4 OR 6X6 TRUCKS WITH AIR BRAKES OR TRACTORS WITH AIR BRAKES AND EQUIPPED WITH BENDIX SR-7 SPRING BRAKE MODULATING VALVES, THE INTERNAL RUBBER CHECK VALVE MAY LEAK CAUSING A DELAY IN THE APPLICATION OF THE SPRING BRAKES TO PARK THE VEHICLE AFTER THE OPERATOR PULLS THE DASH VALVE BUTTON.

title: Suzuki Motor USA, LLC: FRONT SEAT BELT BUCKLE FAILURE (75,697 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN PASSENGER VEHICLES, THE FRONT SEAT BELT TONGUE WILL NOT LATCH INTO THE BUCKLE AND, IN RARE CASES, EVEN THE LOCKED TONGUE WILL POP OUT BY LOW STRETCHING FORCE.  IF THE BUCKLE DOES NOT LATCH COMPLETELY, THE BUCKLE COULD RELEASE WITHOUT PRESSING THE RELEASE BUTTON.

title: FREIGHTLINER LLC: REAR SUSPENSION CENTER CASTING/TUFTRAC (1,200 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN TRUCKS EQUIPPED WITH TUFTRAC REAR SUSPENSIONS, THE CENTER CASTING BRACKETS MAY BE OUT OF SPECIFICATION.  AN OUT OF SQUARE CASTING  MAY HAVE UNACCEPTABLE STRESS IN THE BRACKET WHEN IT IS INSTALLED AND MAY CAUSE IT TO CRACK IN SERVICE.

title: Mack Trucks, Inc.: STEERING SHAFT LOCKNUT (1,072 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN TRUCKS, THE NUT USED TO RETAIN THE STEERING SHAFT MAY OR MAY NOT BE A LOCK NUT THAT HAS THE LOCKING FEATURE.  A LOCK NUT IS REQUIRED TO PROVIDE ADDITIONAL RESISTANCE TO ENSURE THAT THE NUT DOES NOT COME LOOSE.

title: Volvo Trucks North America: STEERING SHAFT LOCKNUT (9,102 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN TRUCKS, THE NUT USED TO RETAIN THE STEERING SHAFT MAY OR MAY NOT BE A LOCK NUT THAT HAS THE LOCKING FEATURE.  A LOCK NUT IS REQUIRED TO PROVIDE ADDITIONAL RESISTANCE TO ENSURE THAT THE NUT DOES NOT COME LOOSE.

title: Caterpillar, Inc.: FUEL PUMP FAILURE (1,680 affected)
summary: CERTAIN CATERPILLAR C7 AND C9 DIESEL ENGINES INSTALLED AS ORIGINAL EQUIPMENT IN TRUCKS AND SCHOOL BUSES.  A FUEL PUMP FAILURE WILL DILUTE THE ENGINE OIL WITH FUEL AND CAUSE LOSS OF THROTTLE CONTROL AND EXCESSIVE SMOKE.

title: Maxzone Auto Parts Corporation: FMVSS 108/AFTERMARKET HEADLAMP ASSEMBLIES (9,145 affected)
summary: CERTAIN MAXZONE HEADLIGHT ASSEMBLIES, DEPO BRAND, P/NOS. 315-1145L-AS AND 315-1145R-AS, SOLD FOR USE AS AFTERMARKET EQUIPMENT FOR THE ABOVE LISTED PASSENGER VEHICLES.  DURING PRODUCTION THE LAMP REFLECTOR SHAPE DEFORMED CHANGING THE SHAPE OF THE OPTIC SURFACE.  THIS WILL CHANGE THE OPPOSITE POSITION OF LOW BEAM AND HIGH BEAM OPTICSAND CHANGE THE ANGLE OF INCIDENCE AND ILLUMATED LOCATION WHICH FAILS TO CONFORM TO THE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 108, LAMPS, REFLECTIVE DEVICES, AND ASSOCIATED EQUIPMENT.

title: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing: REAR PROPELLER SHAFT (108 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN PICKUP TRUCKS EQUIPPED WITH FOUR WHEEL DRIVE, A SECTION OF THE REAR PROPELLER SHAFT MAY HAVE BEEN IMPROPERLY CAST.

title: UCI International LLC: AFTERMARKET FUEL PUMP MODULE ASSEMBLIES/LEAKS (222 affected)
summary: CERTAIN AIRTEX FUEL PUMP MODULE ASSEMBLIES, P/N E7081H, SOLD FOR USE AS REPLACEMENT EQUIPMENT FOR THE VEHICLES LISTED ABOVE.  THE WALL OF THE FLARED FITTING OF THE FUEL PUMP IS NOT THICK ENOUGH TO PREVENT THE MATING THREADED FITTINGS FROM BOTTOMING OUT BEFORE AN ADEQUATE SEAL IS ACHIEVED.  THIS CONDITION MAY RESULT IN LEAKAGE OF FUEL AT THE CONNECTION OF THE VEHICLE FUEL LINE AND THE FUEL PUMP MODULE ASSEMBLY.

title: DAIMLERCHRYSLER MANUFACTURING INTL: FUEL TANK FASTENING STRAPS (461 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN TRUCKS, THE SCREW BOLTS OF THE FUEL TANK FASTENING STRAPS MAY NOT HAVE BEEN TIGHTENED CORRECTLY.  AFTER NORMAL PRODUCTION PROCESS, THE VEHICLES ARE DISASSEMBED FOR SHIPMENT TO THE US AND THE BOLTS MAY NOT HAVE BEEN CORRECTLY TIGHTENED WHEN RE-ASSEMBLED.

title: Daimler Commercial Buses NA: EXHAUST ELBOW (96 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN TRANSIT BUSES BUILT WITH CUMMINS ISL ENGINES, THE EXHAUST ELBOW WAS INCORRECTLY ASSEMBLED AND WELDED DURING PRODUCTION.  THE UPPER FLANGE HAS A BUTT TYPE WELD INSTEAD OF A FILLET TYPE WELD.

title: Keystone RV Company: COOKING RANGE/OVEN THERMOSTAT VALVE/SUBURBAN (16 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN  TRAVEL TRAILERS EQUIPPED WITH SUBURBAN THREE BURNER MATCH LIGHT GAS RANGES, THE OVEN THERMOSTAT CONTROL VALVE CAN ALLOW GAS FLOW TO THE OVEN BURNER WHEN THE OVEN CONTROL KNOB IS PUSHED IN AND NOT FULLY IN THE CORRECT POSITION TO LIGHT THE PILOT.

title: Oshkosh Corporation: VARIABLE VALVE ACTUATION OIL LINE/OIL LEAK (3 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN MILITARY TRUCKS EQUIPPED WITH CATERPILLAR C-15 ENGINES, THE VARIABLE VALVE ACTUATION OIL LINE MAY WEAR AGAINST THE SHARP EDGE OF THE CYLINDER HEAD IF NOT POSITIONED CORRECTLY.

title: Children's Metal Jewelry Recalled by Future Industries Due to Lead Poisoning Hazard
summary: The recalled metal jewelry sets contain high levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 20,000.

title: Serious Intestinal Injury Prompts Kipp Brothers Recall of Mag Stix Magnetic Building Sets
summary: Small magnets inside the plastic sticks can fall out. Magnets found by young children can be swallowed or aspirated. If more than one magnet is swallowed, the magnets can attract each other and cause intestinal perforation or blockage, which can be fatal. Units: About 800.

title: Hammock Stands Recalled by The Algoma Net Co. Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The foot brackets on the hammock frame can crack or tear, causing a consumer to fall to the ground. Units: About 3,000.

title: Infantino Recalls Children's Toy Castles Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The plastic rod can come loose, allowing the colored counting beads to slide off of the toy, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 68,000.

title: Black & Decker Recalls Trimmers/Edgers Due to Laceration Hazard from Projectiles
summary: The trimmer/edger's spool, spool cap and pieces of trimmer string can come loose during use and become airborne projectiles, posing a laceration hazard to the user as well as bystanders. Units: About 202,000.

title: Reclining Lounge Chairs Sold at Menards Stores Recalled for Collapsing Hazard
summary: Faulty support brackets and/or weak frames can cause the chairs to collapse, posing a fall and severe laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 15,000.

title: CVS/pharmacy Announces Recall of Playskool Sippy Cups; Poses Choking Hazard To Young Children
summary: Young children can chew through the plastic spout of the sippy cup, which can pose a choking hazard. Units: About 84,000.

title: New Easy-Bake Oven Recall Following Partial Finger Amputation; Consumers Urged to Return Toy Ovens
summary: Young children can insert their hands into the oven's front opening, and get their hands or fingers caught, posing entrapment and burn hazards. Units: About 1 million.

title: AAFES Expands Recall of "Soldier Bear" Toy Sets Due to Lead Poisoning Hazard
summary: Surface paints on the toy action figures, dinosaurs and animals contain high levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 13,000 (This recall was first announced in May 2007).

title: Atico International USA Recalls Coffeemakers Sold Exclusively at Walgreens Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The coffeemaker can ignite due to an electrical failure, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 392,000.

title: Brake Cylinder Recalled By Magura USA for Brake Failure Hazard on Off-Road Motorcycles
summary: The brake cylinder on the off-road motorcycle can crack and result in brake failure. This poses a risk of severe injury or death to the driver. Units: About 200.

title: Vance Kitira Recalls Cinnamon Spice Candles Due to Fire Hazard
summary: There are no instructions on the candle, warning consumers to remove the cinnamon sticks and trim the wick, before lighting the candle. The cinnamon sticks can ignite, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 2,000.

title: Children's Earrings Sold at Wal-Mart Stores in Florida Recalled by Uncas Manufacturing Co. Due to Lead Poisoning Hazard
summary: The recalled metal earring sets contain high levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 220.

title: Injuries Prompt Recall of Combination Tire Inflator and Hand Pumps by Genuine Innovations
summary: The combination tire inflator and hand pump can shatter under pressure when inflating tires if there is a blockage in the tire valve, posing the risk of bruises, lacerations, and ringing in the ears to consumers. Units: About 55,000.

title: Ol' Man Treestands Recalled by TSR Inc.; Locking Pins Can Unexpectedly Fall Out, Posing a Fall Hazard
summary: The locking pins in the treestands can come out unexpectedly, exposing consumers to possible injury due to a fall. Units: About 9,000 treestands, and about 500 replacement pin sets sold separately.

title: Payless ShoeSource Expands Recall of Children's Clog Shoes Due to Choking Hazard
summary: Plastic rivets used to attach the strap to the shoe can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 270,000 (This recall was first announced in June 2007).

title: Petters Consumer Brands Recalls Sunbeam Over-the-Range Microwaves for Fire Hazard
summary: Internal electrical arcing in the microwave can pose a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 300.

title: Sportsman's Warehouse Recalls Flashlights; Counterfeit Batteries Can Overheat, Posing a Fire Hazard
summary: The batteries packaged with the recalled flashlights are labeled as "Panasonic CR123A Industrial Lithium" and have been determined by Panasonic to be counterfeit. The counterfeit batteries can overheat and rupture, posing a fire and burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 4,400.

title: Batteries Used with Power Tools Recalled by Milwaukee Electric Tool Co. Due To Laceration Hazard
summary: If a vent on the battery cell is damaged or compromised during use, the battery can explode and pose a laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 1 million.

title: Meyer Recalls Cooking Torches Due to Fire Hazard
summary: Butane fuel can leak from the torch assembly near the nozzle, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 4,400 (about 40 with consumers).

title: Gamewell-FCI Recalls to Upgrade Software Used with Fire Alarm System Control Panels
summary: The software in the fire alarm system could fail to recognize when a detector needs servicing as a result of the buildup of dust, dirt, or other environmental pollutants, which could result in the system failing to respond in the event of a fire. Units: About 1,100.

title: Coldwater Creek Recalls Sweaters Due to Burn Hazard
summary: Should the sweater come in contact with an ignition source, such as a stove burner, candle flame or cigarette lighter, it could catch fire and cause serious burns to consumers. Units: About 3,500.

title: Frozen Carbonated Beverage Dispensers Recalled by IMI Cornelius Due to Fire Hazard
summary: A problem with the dispenser's florescent lamp can cause electrical arcing, which poses a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 8,000 (This recall was first announced in Sept. 2004).

title: Pacifiers Decorated with Crystals Recalled Due to Aspiration and Ingestion Hazards
summary: The pacifiers' crystals can separate easily, posing an aspiration and ingestion hazard to young children. Units: About 1,000.

title: The Toro Company Recalls Electric Blowers Due to Projectile Hazards
summary: The blower's impeller, which is a rotating component on the blower, can break, resulting in pieces of plastic flying out of the blower. This poses a risk of serious injury to the user or a bystander. Units: About 900,000.

title: Sauder Woodworking Recalls TV Stands Due to Collapse Hazard
summary: The TV stand can collapse if the fasteners used to connect the metal legs to the lower shelf are not completely tightened during assembly, posing a risk that the TV set can fall onto children or adults. Units: About 414,000.

title: Additional Incidents Prompt Log Splitter Recall Expansion by Brave Products; Could Pose Serious Injury Risk
summary: The log splitter's hydraulic cylinders can have defective rod retention, causing the seals to leak and the rods to detach. This can result in serious injury to the operator, as the rod can rapidly and unexpectedly extend the splitting wedge. Units: About 8,000 (This recall was first announced in Feb

title: Pottery Barn Kids Recalls Crib Bumpers Due to Entanglement Hazard
summary: The decorative stitching on the bumper's edge can come loose, posing an entanglement hazard to young children. Units: About 31,000.

title: Risk of Explosion and Hearing Damage Prompts Recall of Remote Control Airplanes
summary: The airplanes are launched by hand and can explode near the consumer's head, posing a risk of temporary hearing loss and injuries to eyes, face and hands. Units: About 21,000.
